info.name: GrossPay API — Bangladesh (BDT)
info.description:
Requests for the GrossPay Bangladesh integration: deposits (bKash, Nagad, BanglaQR, card) and payouts (wallets, bank accounts).

**Setup**
1. Import this collection and the *GrossPay BD — Test* environment.
2. Select the environment and set `apiKey` (your **test** API key).
3. Set `callbackUri` to your webhook endpoint or a request-bin URL (e.g. webhook.site) to see webhooks.
4. Run *1. Pay-in → Create deposit*, open `hosted_url`, pay. IDs are saved automatically for the status requests.

Every request has tests (see *Test Results*). Folder *5. Negative tests* checks error handling.

Webhooks are sent from IP `136.148.218.118` and signed (`signature-v1`, RSA-SHA256). Postman cannot receive them — use your endpoint or a request bin.

Full documentation: https://github.com/grosspay-bd/doc

item.name: 1. Pay-in (debit)
item.description: Deposits via hosted payment page: wallet (bKash/Nagad), BanglaQR, card. Docs: https://github.com/grosspay-bd/doc/blob/main/docs/02-pay-in.md

request.description:
Creates a deposit with a fresh `merchant_ref` (`order_bd_<timestamp>`).

Open `hosted_url` from the response (also printed in the Postman console and saved to the `hostedUrl` variable) to pay with bKash and enter the TrxID.

**Credit the customer only after a signed webhook with `posted` / `part_posted`, using `amount_posted`.**

exec: if (d.hosted_url) { pm.collectionVariables.set('hostedUrl', d.hosted_url); console.log('Open to pay:', d.hosted_url); }

request.description: Nagad wallet transfer. `holder_account` (optional) is the wallet the customer will pay from; it is normalised and returned in the payment object (may be masked).
The page shows a BanglaQR code; the customer scans it with the bKash / Nagad app. `route_network`: `bkash` or `nagad`.
Card payment on the hosted page. `route_network` is not sent for cards.
Uses `debitPaymentId` saved by *Create deposit*. State is cached — webhooks are the source of truth.
Same payment, looked up by your own `merchant_ref`. This is how you recover after a timeout on `POST /payments/init`.

item.name: 2. Pay-out (credit)
item.description: Payouts to wallets (bKash/Nagad/Rocket/Upay) and bank accounts. Docs: https://github.com/grosspay-bd/doc/blob/main/docs/03-pay-out.md

request.description:
Sends `payoutAmount` to `walletNumber` (environment variables).

Accepted number formats: `01712345678`, `8801712345678`, `+880 1712-345678`; normalised value must match `^01[3-9]\d{8}$`, otherwise error `474`.

⚠️ In Production this sends real money.

exec: pm.test('No hosted_url for payouts', () => pm.expect(d.hosted_url == null).to.be.true);

request.description: Same as above, wallet given as `+880 1712-345678` — GrossPay normalises it to `01712345678`.
Payout to a Nagad wallet (`nagadWallet`). Same contract as bKash, different `route_network`.

Payout to a bank account. Set `bankCode` (from the bank directory), `bankAccount` and `routingNumber` in the environment. `payee_title` is required for bank payouts.

BEFTN payouts run on business days only (weekend: Fri–Sat) — `queued` can last until the next business day. Do not cancel or re-send.

⚠️ In Production this sends real money.
Uses `creditPaymentId` saved by the last *Create payout*.
Merchant balance. Check it before payout batches.
**Before sending:** in the *Body* tab select a receipt file for `file1` (1–3 files total). Do not set Content-Type manually.

item.name: 5. Negative tests
item.description: Expected errors — use them to check your error handling. Docs: https://github.com/grosspay-bd/doc/blob/main/docs/07-errors.md

request.description: Wallet `0171234` is too short → business error `474`.
Third digit must be 3–9.
`holder_account` is validated with the same rules as payout wallet numbers.
`route_network` (bank code) is required for `route_kind: bank`. The same error with `fault.at: ["route_network"]` is returned for any method/network not enabled for your account.
Sends `Authorization: <API_KEY>` without `Bearer ` — must be rejected with 403.
`holder_ref` is missing → `fault.class: validation`, field listed in `fault.at`.
`merchant_ref` must be 5–64 characters.
Adjust the amount to just below your account minimum if 1.00 is allowed.
